head_pair: (a) H1 senior-partner-whose-example-associates-copy + H4 lie told before two mentored junior associates  vs  (b) H2 party lied to is a dependent elderly widow least able to check him + H3 eight-month settled continuance
case_a_worse: The senior tax partner is a person of eminency 'whose example is likely to be followed' (Q151 head 1) — every junior associate shadows and imitates him. He told the lie IN FRONT OF two juniors he was mentoring that day, so he modeled to the next generation of CPAs that a smooth lie is how a respected professional escapes his own bungle (Q151 head 4, before others; a stumbling-occasion). The commandment's concern for our neighbor's good name (Q145) is compounded by the corruption of the watching juniors' consciences. His later remorse is only a MITIGATION — it does not touch the two live head-1 and head-4 aggravations of the act itself, which are what make it grave. A lie taught by example to those who will repeat it multiplies far beyond the one client.
case_b_worse: The mid-level CPA preys on exactly the helpless the ninth commandment most protects — an elderly widow wholly dependent on him for the truth about her own estate account, and least able to detect the deceit (Q151 head 2: the weaker and more dependent the party, the heavier). And it is no single slip but a settled eight-month deception, deliberate and sustained (Q151 head 3 continuance) — the hardened, calculated persistence Q151 marks as gravest. A year of lying to a defenseless widow who trusts you completely, stringing her along month after month, is the settled fraud of the vulnerable; the partner's single lie, however public, was one act he then repented of, while this is an ongoing, unrepented predation still in motion.
why_neither_wins: The Standards give no algebra to net (a)'s two uncancelled aggravations (office-example + lie-before-mentored-juniors, on heads 1 and 4) against (b)'s two uncancelled aggravations (dependent-vulnerable-party + eight-month-continuance, on heads 2 and 3). They fall on DIFFERENT heads with no common scale: publicity-and-example-corruption vs vulnerability-and-persistence. (a)'s single-occasion + remorse are mitigations that reduce ITS continuance weight but cannot cancel (b)'s aggravations, and (b)'s privacy cannot cancel (a)'s. Both are real, uncancelled, multi-head aggravations; a confident total order asserts a scale the Standards do not supply.

setting: regional trucking/logistics company (dispatch deciding which termination case to build)
head_pair: (a) H3 endangerment done 'with delight'/relishing the family's terror (single, one vehicle)  vs  (b) H2 many vulnerable parties endangered (pedestrians, school-zone children, drivers) + H3 quarter-long deliberate-negligence continuance
case_a_worse: The road-rage driver deliberately terrorized a family — boxing in and brake-checking their minivan for miles — and the dashcam shows he was grinning and enjoying their fear. A sin done 'with delight' in the very quality of the act is deeper than one done in mere heat or passion; the relishing of others' terror is a hardness of heart Q151 head 3 marks as an aggravation of the nature-and-quality of the offence. To take PLEASURE in endangering and frightening parents and children reveals a settled cruelty of disposition that cold negligence does not; the delight itself is the gravest feature.
case_b_worse: The negligent driver exposes the WHOLE PUBLIC — hundreds of pedestrians, children in the school zone, other drivers — to a fatigued man in a poorly-maintained rig, and does so every single shift for a quarter (Q151 head 2: the more and weaker the parties endangered; head 3: settled continuance). The sixth commandment requires 'all careful studies and lawful endeavors to preserve life' (Q135) and forbids 'neglecting the lawful means of preservation of life' (Q136). One relished incident endangered one family once; this diffuse, sustained, deliberate negligence multiplies a real and growing risk of death across the many vulnerable the commandment most protects, week after week. The breadth-and-persistence is the graver exposure.
why_neither_wins: (a)'s uncancelled aggravation is on head 3 (delight/relish in the act's quality); (b)'s are on head 2 (many, vulnerable parties) and head 3-continuance (a quarter-long pattern). The 'no single dramatic choice' framing is not a mitigation of (b) — it is the very form its head-2/head-3 aggravation takes. There is no common scale to net the intensive evil of relished cruelty toward one family against the extensive evil of settled negligence endangering hundreds of the vulnerable. Both orderings stand on genuine Standards grounds; a confident total order overclaims.

setting: community choral society rehearsing/performing on Sundays (board chair deciding which section leader to address)
head_pair: (a) H3 deliberate/willful weekly continuance in personal Sabbath-profaning (harms his own duty only)  vs  (b) H2 causing the weak/new-believers to be kept from the hour of public worship against conscience, via authority over their solos/standing
case_a_worse: The first section leader profanes the whole Lord's Day deliberately, willfully, and by settled weekly habit — treating the entire day the Lord claims as his own for errands and recreations he could do any other day (Q151 head 3: deliberateness and continuance both engaged; Q119 forbids profaning the day 'by unnecessary works... and recreations'). A hardened, every-single-week contempt for the day God has set apart is a settled personal profanation, not a lapse. The persistence and willfulness — a fixed pattern of claiming God's day for himself — is the gravest feature of his conduct.
case_b_worse: The second section leader wounds the SOULS of others: she uses her authority over the young singers' solos and standing to compel four of them — two new believers who plainly said they wanted to be in worship — to attend rehearsal during the very hour of public worship, keeping the weak from church against their conscience (Q151 head 2: the party offended and the souls of others; Q118 lays on superiors the charge NOT to cause those under them to profane the day). Q119's abuse compounds when authority binds weaker consciences. Her own Sabbath conduct is not the issue — it is that she drives the vulnerable away from worship against their will, a harm reaching others' souls, which the first man's purely self-regarding profanation never does.
why_neither_wins: (a)'s uncancelled aggravation is on head 3 (deliberate weekly personal continuance); (b)'s is on head 2 (causing the weak/new-believers to be kept from worship against conscience, via authority — souls of others). One harm is confined to the offender's own duty; the other reaches and wounds the souls of dependent others through abuse of authority. There is no common scale to net a hardened, willful personal profanation against the authority-driven keeping-of-the-weak-from-worship. Both orderings are genuinely defensible; a confident total order asserts an algebra the Standards do not supply.

setting: small bookkeeping/tax-prep practice (owner deciding which preparer to move on first) — REPAIRED s7: (a) recast from H1+H4 to H1+H3-settled-habit (dropped came-to-me-uneasy + two-trained-juniors beats) to break the template-twin with CONT-N-032
head_pair: (a) H1 senior-preparer-whose-example-juniors-copy (padding is a settled repeated habit across many invoices, H3 shared) — distinct head H1  vs  (b) H2 party stolen from is his especially-obligated aunt/benefactor who raised him (H3 shared) — distinct head H2
case_a_worse: The senior preparer is a person 'whose example is likely to be followed' (Q151 head 1) — every junior shadows and imitates him, and his handling of clients sets the standard the whole staff copies. He has made invoice-padding his settled routine across many clients' bills for the better part of a year, so the office's rising generation absorbs fraud as the normal way the work is done (Q151 head 1: the example-weight of the man they model). Q142 forbids 'fraudulent dealing' and 'unjust ways of taking from our neighbor what belongs to him'; here the fraud is not an isolated slip but the entrenched, culture-setting standard of the office's most-copied man — a corruption that propagates far past any one client.
case_b_worse: The quieter preparer steals from his own aunt — the widow who took him in and raised him after his parents died, the person he stands most especially obligated to (Q151 head 2: the nearer and more obligated the relation to the party wronged, the heavier). To rob one's own benefactor-guardian, a dependent widow who trusts him and would never check, compounds theft with the deepest ingratitude and betrayal of a filial-type bond. And it is no single act but a settled year-long skimming, deliberate and sustained (Q151 head 3 continuance). A hardened year of thieving from the woman who raised you is a relational treachery the office-standard fraud never approaches on the relation axis.
why_neither_wins: Both sides share the continuance axis (H3 — a settled year-long routine each), so continuance does not discriminate. (a)'s distinct uncancelled aggravation is on head 1 (office/example — the man everyone models has made padding the office's normal); (b)'s distinct uncancelled aggravation is on head 2 (the especially-obligated aunt-benefactor who raised him). (a)'s lack of a special relation to its padded clients does not cancel (b)'s relation-weight, and (b)'s privacy does not cancel (a)'s example-weight. Both are real, uncancelled aggravations on different heads with no common scale — office-example-corruption vs relational-betrayal. A confident total order overclaims.

setting: community concert band (director deciding which leader to address first)
head_pair: (a) H1 assistant-conductor-whose-example-the-band-follows, repeated devised bow-toward-the-shrine worship-ritual  vs  (b) H4 single open image-worship staged publicly at the concert before hundreds of townspeople and a visiting church youth group
case_a_worse: The assistant conductor is 'a person whose example is likely to be followed' (Q151 head 1) — the whole band imitates him and he sets the ensemble's culture. He has instituted a SETTLED, REPEATED will-worship: leading the players to bow toward a homemade shrine and recite his own invented invocation at nearly every rehearsal, presenting it as how they 'consecrate' their playing (Q109 forbids worshiping God 'by any... way not appointed in his word'). A leader everyone models who repeatedly trains the whole band into a self-devised, unappointed worship corrupts the ensemble's worship from within, over and over — the office-and-example aggravation that reshapes the culture is the gravest feature.
case_b_worse: The percussionist staged OPEN image-worship — bowing down to an elaborate carved idol-figure at the front of the stage — at the packed outdoor concert, before hundreds of townspeople AND a visiting church youth group seated in the front rows (Q151 head 4: place and publicity aggravate). Q109 forbids 'the making any representation of God... and the worshiping of it.' Open idol-worship staged before hundreds of outsiders scandalizes many at once and models idolatry directly to the watching young people — a public stumbling-occasion of the gravest visible kind. The sheer publicity before outsiders and the corruption of the watching youth is a scandal the assistant conductor's in-house ritual, seen only by the band, never reaches.
why_neither_wins: (a)'s uncancelled aggravation is on head 1 (office/example-followed, a repeated devised will-worship); (b)'s is on head 4 (open public image-worship before hundreds and before the visiting youth). Both are real second-commandment offenses (will-worship / image-worship, Q109); neither is mitigation-loaded. There is no common scale to net the culture-corrupting office-example of a repeated in-house devised worship against the public scandal of a single but open image-worship staged before hundreds of outsiders and watching youth. Both orderings stand on genuine Standards grounds; a confident total order overclaims.
